question: Q2 necessity: replace the value, recount the exact outcome
number: Not necessary for the attack, necessary for the target. Replacing v8 = 0x6a09e667 by the random constant 0x522c4f8d: (a) circuit: 2000 random replacement values give 595..595 ops (595 for all; an op is saved only if a derived constant hits 0, probability about 2^-32 per site); (b) tag collision test on the real 3-round chain, n=32, 1000 runs: mean/pred = 0.997 +- 0.016 (standard state 1.018 +- 0.016), random-mapping law kept; (c) the 1000 colliding pairs found under the modified state also collide in the 32-bit tag under the standard state in 0 of 1000 cases (expected 2^-32 each). So the cost of the search does not depend on the value, but the pair only collides for the specified function: the target fixes v8 = 0x6a09e667 (IV[0], a constant of every compression, also in keyed mode).
notes: universe cell blake3-r3|INIT.v8|INIT|Q2. n=32 tag from digest word 0 (and 1); 3 rounds; fixed seed; pair check uses the standard-state function on the same two inputs. validation: b3r3lib.py selftest (7-round official vectors for empty input and [0]; organizer verifier/blake3.py at 3 and 7 rounds on 600 random 0^32||x; trace total 595 and per-kind counts = filed rho.py PH/PH_BY)
